nodes.Name: Floor
nodes.DocComment:
Floor returns the greatest integer value less than or equal to x.

Special cases are:

	Floor(±0) = ±0
	Floor(±Inf) = ±Inf
	Floor(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Ceil
nodes.DocComment:
Ceil returns the least integer value greater than or equal to x.

Special cases are:

	Ceil(±0) = ±0
	Ceil(±Inf) = ±Inf
	Ceil(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Trunc
nodes.DocComment:
Trunc returns the integer value of x.

Special cases are:

	Trunc(±0) = ±0
	Trunc(±Inf) = ±Inf
	Trunc(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Round
nodes.DocComment:
Round returns the nearest integer, rounding half away from zero.

Special cases are:

	Round(±0) = ±0
	Round(±Inf) = ±Inf
	Round(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: RoundToEven
nodes.DocComment:
RoundToEven returns the nearest integer, rounding ties to even.

Special cases are:

	RoundToEven(±0) = ±0
	RoundToEven(±Inf) = ±Inf
	RoundToEven(NaN) = NaN
